name: comp-147
title: Icon Grid Checkboxes
description: 2-column grid of checkbox cards with lucide-react icons. Each card includes a checkbox, icon, and label. One card pre-checked by default.
use: Selecting tools, features, or options with visual icons.
avoid: Too many options: grid becomes overwhelming.
a11y: Each checkbox properly labeled. Icons are aria-hidden. Grid is semantically neutral. Full keyboard navigation.
